recent.reason: Hawaii Firm Recalls Frozen Pork Products Due To Misbranding and Undeclared Allergen. Kulana Foods Ltd., a Hilo, Hawaii establishment is recalling approximately 4,465 pounds of frozen, fully cooked pork products because of misbranding and an undeclared allergen. The products are formulated with a soy sauce that contains wheat, a known allergen, which is not declared on the label.
